title: Sensor Source Rule for Customers Holding an Insulin Pump Program: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
Holding an insulin pump program changes what a Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program (CGM program) may carry.

## The rule

1. When the customer holds a pump program that is not closed, the CGM model written on the CGM program must be one that pump model accepts under the pump compatibility register, so that the pump's automated insulin delivery keeps its sensor source; a model change to a model the pump does not accept is not made, and the customer is told the prescriber must order a compatible model.
2. A customer whose pump program that is not closed is on a pump whose compatibility list is empty (the MiniMed 780G) receives that manufacturer's sensors under the pump program, and a CGM program sensor refill (A4239) is not shipped to that customer, because a payer pays only one CGM supply allowance per month; the CGM program may be discontinued by the customer or held at the customer's request.
3. A customer with no pump program, or whose pump program is closed, may hold any model the written order names.

## Decision table

| Customer's pump program | Pump's compatibility list | CGM model on the CGM program | CGM sensor refill |
|---|---|---|---|
| None, or closed | Not consulted | Any model the written order names | Not restricted by this rule |
| Not closed | Lists the CGM model | Allowed | Not restricted by this rule |
| Not closed | Does not list a requested new model | The model change is not made | Not restricted by this rule |
| Not closed, MiniMed 780G | Empty | No model is on the list | Not shipped; the customer receives that manufacturer's sensors under the pump program |

## Basis questions

- *Can a customer with an open Tandem Mobi pump program change to FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus?* No; that pump's list does not include it, so the change is not made and the customer is told the prescriber must order a compatible model.
- *What if that pump program is closed?* The customer may hold any model the written order names.
